about: Eval set for the hypothesis verdict of a Research (initiative 'research'). Each case is one verdict call: the hypotheses listed, against the 60 synthetic feedback of evals/dataset.json (or the subset named in 'feedback'), plus any 'extra_feedback' of the case appended at the end. Written before the prompt, from .builderos/initiatives/research/04-spec.md. Feedback ids refer to evals/dataset.json; ids starting with x are defined in the case. Verdict values are the model's enum: confirmed, refuted, to_review. Expectations are checked on the output after the app's checks (checkVerdicts), except G1, which reads the raw model output.

threshold.must_pass: every case with must_pass true, and check G1 on every case with zero violations

global_checks.G1: Every quote in the raw model output is an exact substring (after trim) of the text of the feedback it names. Zero violations across the whole set.
global_checks.G2: Every span between quotation marks ("...", “...”, «...») in a reasoning text is an exact substring of some feedback text sent in that call.
global_checks.G3: No reasoning text contains a count of feedback or customers written as digits: regex /\b\d+\s+(feedback|clienti|utenti|persone|iscritti|segnalazioni|customers|users)\b/i does not match.
global_checks.G4: After the app's checks, every hypothesis has at most 3 'for' quotes and at most 2 'against' quotes, at most 1 quote per feedback, and no feedback linked both for and against.
global_checks.G5: After the app's checks, every hypothesis sent has exactly one verdict, one of confirmed, refuted, to_review; a confirmed verdict has at least 1 verified 'for' quote and a refuted verdict at least 1 verified 'against' quote.

case_checks.verdict: The verdict after the app's checks is one of 'verdict' (a string or a list of accepted values).
case_checks.for_allowed: Every feedback linked 'for' after the checks is in this list. Omitted means no constraint.
case_checks.against_allowed: Every feedback linked 'against' after the checks is in this list. Omitted means no constraint.
case_checks.min_for_quotes: At least this many verified 'for' quotes after the checks.
case_checks.min_against_quotes: At least this many verified 'against' quotes after the checks.
case_checks.max_quotes: At most this many verified quotes (for and against together) after the checks.
case_checks.forbidden: None of these strings appears in the reasoning text.
case_checks.forbidden_links: None of these feedback is linked, for or against, after the checks.
